full_page.content:
1935, April 19th
The following is a faithful transcription of photo copies of handwritten messages on Seraphic Mass Association Cards by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F.M. Cap.
Richard Werthman 5063 Baldwin Ave. Apr. 19th, 1935 Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
1948, October 7th
Mrs. E. J. Werthman
-- for speedy health-recovery God willing --
Special --
0 Course we are glad to include you in our prayers. Do not worry.
October 7th --- 1948 Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
The original in possession of: Mrs. Marie Werthman 8305. Riverland Drive, Apt. 3 Sterling Hts .Mich. 48078
